acceptance.description: Checked, idempotent session lifecycle without project-file deletion
Usable actual desktop session organization and correct selection/draft state
Bounded redacted local execution observations with honest limits
Current native and static regressions preserve existing architecture and security
Verified macOS package, captures and independent final reviews with parent gaps retained

unit.scope: Session lifecycle, receipt safety, diagnostics redaction, navigation projection and existing core regressions

typecheck.scope: Desktop renderer and typed preload contract

bundle.scope: Renderer excludes privileged host and sidecar modules

boundaries.scope: Desktop resolved imports, public APIs, FSD directions and browser/host separation with positive and negative fixtures

electron-e2e.scope: Disposable actual Electron startup, UI controls, authentic unavailable-provider behavior and shutdown

package-macos.scope: Local macOS app package with pinned sidecar resources; no publication

electron-session-e2e.scope: Actual Electron session organization/fork/delete and local diagnostics with disposable sidecar data and project-file sentinels

electron-ui-states.scope: Existing actual-renderer synthetic tool/permission/unknown-state and layout regressions

packaged-lifecycle.scope: Current native macOS package launch, sender isolation, sidecar crash/restart and owned cleanup

decision_register.statement: Continue authorized local implementation using the selected Electron/sidecar architecture.
decision_register.source: User explicitly enabled full approval mode and requested autonomous remaining work; earlier product platform choices remain.
decision_register.impact: Reversible local implementation and disposable tests; no publication or personal credential use.
decision_register.resolution: Deliver the bounded session lifecycle increment, preserving all F-01-18 parent requirements.

decision_register.statement: Keep session pin/archive and observation data in the existing temporary runtime.
decision_register.source: Permanent data path/retention remains an unresolved parent choice.
decision_register.impact: No silent permanent storage; organization is explicitly lost with the temporary runtime.
decision_register.resolution: Use reversible app metadata; durable data selection/recovery stays in the parent backlog.

decision_register.statement: Implement user-triggered native-confirmed conversation deletion, not filesystem deletion.
decision_register.source: Approved PRD F-03/F-04 and autonomous implementation instruction.
decision_register.impact: App UI must show the exact target and preserve project directories; development uses disposable sessions only.
decision_register.resolution: Default-cancel native dialog, idle/ownership rechecks, descendant guard and duplicate receipts before/after exact SDK removal.
